name: elosern-webclient
description: Elosern WebClient Vue 3 SPA (view layer only). Deterministic game state, the OOB protocol, and the transport are owned by the Evennia server; this package builds an offline self-contained bundle from the project origin and is a dev/CI-time dependency only (no runtime Node.js or pnpm dependency). The root stays CommonJS so the dependency-free Node gate under web/static/webclient/js keeps running under node --test; the Vue app sources are ESM via web/webclient-app/package.json.

scripts.favicon: npx --yes realfavicon@0.9.3 generate web/brand/elosern-mark.svg web/brand/realfavicon-settings.json web/brand/favicon-markups.json web/static/favicon
